test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 15 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Why did Mother Teresa establish the ‘Nirmal Hriday’ Hospice?

options.text: To provide a place where the terminally ill could die in peace
To provide a home for orphan girl-children
To provide a refuge for patients of leprosy
To provide a home for young widows

solution:
The correct answer is __**To provide a place where the terminally ill could die in peace**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mother Teresa established the** Nirmal Hriday Hospice to provide a place where the terminally ill could die in peace**
 
• Mother Teresa c**onverted an abandoned Hindu temple into the hospice with the help of Indian officials **
 
• On 22 August 1952, a couple of years after founding the Missionaries of Charity, Mother Teresa inaugurated her first “home for the dying", Nirmal Hriday in Kalighat.
 
• It is a place where the poorest of the poor can die a “beautiful death", as the nun would often say.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mother Teresa was the first woman the close Indian ties to get the 1979 Nobel Peace Prize. 

 
 
• Mother Teresa was born in Macedonia (then Ottoman Empire's Uskup) to parents of Albanian descent.
 
• Mother Teresa came to India in 1929.
 
• She was sent to Calcutta to be a teacher after she entered a nunnery.
 
• After coming to India, she decided to serve the poor as she lived amongst them.
 
• The pious lady was awarded Padma Shri in 1962 and Bharat Ratna in 1980.
 
• She breathed her last breath on 5 September 1997.
